run_bodymocap_on_video: run bodymocap on a video file using --vPath to detect 3D human poses and SMPL meshes
run_bodymocap_on_webcam: run bodymocap on live webcam input using --webcam flag for real-time 3D pose estimation
run_bodymocap_on_url: run bodymocap on a YouTube URL using --url and --download to fetch and process video
run_bodymocap_export_pkl: run bodymocap with --pklout to export SMPL pose parameters and vertices as pickle files
run_bodymocap_single_person: run bodymocap with --single to reconstruct only the largest person in the scene
